newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes lower led by Komercni Banka.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes lower led by Komercni Banka.

text.p: Czech shares continued to decline on Tuesday led by the PX50 index's biggest banking issue Komercni Banka which lost 3.4 percent to 2,222.
The PX50 fell 0.7 points, 0.13 percent, to 537.9 while the Reuters RPIX index of continuously traded shares dropped 4.2 points, 0.38 percent, to 1,115.7.

Dealers said Komercni, which in common with all blue chips has been falling for several weeks, was now beginning to look cheap and that investors may soon be attracted back into the share. "I think that probably its getting a little bit too cheap," said Lubomir vystavel of ING Barings.

While most blue chips lost ground, shares in the biggest Czech engineering company Skoda Plzen rose after the company said it had won an order to supply trolley buses worth $170 million to the U.S. city of San Francisco.
"I think it's probably the reaction to it (the order)," said Vystavel. The order is the largest supply of Czech goods ever to the United States.
Overall, activity was very low with turnover at just 690 million crowns.
